messages.text:
"Create a high-quality 3D third-person action RPG inspired by the fast-paced combat of Devil May Cry 5 and the precise, stylish combat mechanics of Punishing: Gray Raven.

GAME TITLE: ECLIPSE – THE FALLEN KINGDOM

GENRE: Dark Fantasy, Hack and Slash, Action RPG.

WORLD:
Set in a dark medieval fantasy world where an ancient demonic force has corrupted kingdoms, destroyed civilizations, and awakened forgotten monsters. The world contains ruined castles, gothic cities, ancient forests, underground temples, and mysterious dungeons.

MAIN CHARACTER:
Create a young male warrior with silver hair, black medieval armor, a long coat, and a mysterious past. He carries a powerful transforming sword and possesses supernatural abilities.

COMBAT SYSTEM:

- Extremely fast and fluid sword combat.
- Stylish combos inspired by Devil May Cry.
- Perfect dodges and counterattacks.
- Multiple weapons and combat styles.
- Special abilities with spectacular visual effects.
- Aerial combos, launchers, and juggling enemies.
- Cinematic ultimate attacks.
- Challenging boss battles with multiple phases.
- Character switching during combat.

CHARACTERS:
Create three playable characters with completely different fighting styles:

1. A fast swordmaster focused on speed and aerial combos.
2. A heavy knight using a giant sword and powerful attacks.
3. A mysterious female warrior using dual blades and magical abilities.

PROGRESSION:

- Unlock new combat abilities and combos.
- Upgrade weapons and armor.
- Discover new playable characters.
- Unlock ultimate abilities.
- Develop a deep story through cinematic cutscenes.

GAMEPLAY STRUCTURE:
Create story-based missions with exploration, enemy encounters, mini-bosses, and major boss fights. Include interconnected locations and hidden secrets.

GRAPHICS:
High-quality 3D graphics, detailed character models, realistic weapon animations, dramatic lighting, dark fantasy environments, cinematic effects, and smooth animations.

IMPORTANT:
The game must prioritize gameplay and combat quality over complicated systems. No gacha, no energy system, no mandatory daily missions, and no pay-to-win mechanics.

Make the combat feel responsive, satisfying, challenging, and visually spectacular. Create an original game rather than copying existing characters or assets. (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
